declare
 temp varchar2(30);
 temp1 varchar2(5);
begin
 nullchk; check_package_failure;

 select 'temp' into temp1 
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type and
 code_type = 'GOALS' and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.custodian','D'); 
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.pb_custodian','D'); 
 :ctrl_block_1.Custodian := null ;
 :ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := null ;

 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'INGOL' then
 select inst_short_name,inst_id 
 into :ctrl_block_1.Custodian ,:ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian
 from institutions 
 where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.Custodian',navigable,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FXGOL' then
 :ctrl_block_1.Custodian := 'Fixed Goal' ;
 :ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := 'FXGOL' ;
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FLGOL' then
 :ctrl_block_1.Custodian := 'Field Goal' ;
 :ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := 'FLGOL' ;
 else
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.custodian','E');
 temp := null;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'DNGOL' then
 temp := 'lov_donor'; 
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'SPGOL' then
 temp := 'lov_sponsor'; 
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TRGOL' then
 temp := 'lov_territory'; 
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'STGOL' then
 temp := 'lov_sites'; 
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'RECTR' then
 temp := 'lov_recrt'; 
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TELRC' then
 temp := 'lov_telrc'; 
 elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FCGOL' then
 temp := 'lov_fcgol';
 /*elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FLGOL' or :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FXGOL' then
 temp := 'lov_chapters';*/
 end if;
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.custodian',lov_name,temp);
 if temp is not null then
 ITEM_CHANGE('ctrl_block_1.pb_custodian','E');
 end if;
 end if;
 check_retrieve;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11247');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

declare
 temp number :=0 ;
 nRectr Number:=0;
 local_date date;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 
 local_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'SPGOL' then
 begin
 select sponsor_id
 into :g_custodian
 from sponsors 
 where upper(name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and local_date between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,local_date+10) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TRGOL' then
 begin
 select territory_id
 into :g_custodian
 from valid_territories 
 where upper(territory_short_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,local_date+10) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'STGOL' then
 begin
 select site_id
 into :g_custodian
 from fixed_sites a, locations b
 where a.site_id = b.location_id
 and decode(a.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and decode(b.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,b.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and upper(b.location_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'RECTR' then
 begin
 
 select count(*) into nRectr
 from employees
 where upper(first_name||' '||last_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and emp_class='RECRT'
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and local_date between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,local_date+10);
 If nRectr =1 then
 select staff_no
 into :g_custodian
 from employees
 where upper(first_name||' '||last_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and emp_class='RECRT'
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and local_date between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,local_date+10) and rownum=1;
 Elsif nRectr > 1 then 
 If :g_custodian is null then -- g_custodian is populating from the LOV selection.
 show_error('0069','- Use [LISTVAL) to select the correct staff');
 check_package_failure;
 Else 
 Null;
 End If;
 Else
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 End If; 
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 handle_error ; 
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TELRC' then
 begin
 select staff_no into :g_custodian
 from employees
 where upper(first_name||' '||last_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and emp_class='TELRC'
 and decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and local_date between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,local_date+10) and rownum=1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'DNGOL' then
 begin
 select donors.donor_id into :g_custodian
 from donors,donor_interdictions donint 
 where donors.donor_id=donint.donor_id 
 and first_name||' '||last_name = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and decode(donors.chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,donors.chapter_id)=:global.chapter_id 
 and donint.inter_code='DGOAL' 
 and donint.chapter_id = donors.chapter_id 
 and local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,local_date+10)
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FCGOL' then
 BEGIN
 SELECT code INTO :g_custodian
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'FACLT'
 AND code = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 AND local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,local_date+10);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('11280');
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 end if;
 check_retrieve;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp varchar2(1);
 new_id varchar2(10);
begin
 if :goals.goal_id is null then
 create_ids('GOAL',new_id);
 :goals.goal_id := new_id;
 end if;
 if :goals.goal_MMYY is null then
 :goals.goal_MMYY := to_char(:s_goals.month,'MMYYYY');
 end if;
 if :goals.chapter_id is null then
 :goals.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
 if :goals.GOAL_TYPE is null then
 :goals.GOAL_TYPE := :CTRL_BLOCK_1.GOAL_TYPE;
 end if;
 if :goals.GOAL_CUSTODIAN is null then
 :goals.GOAL_CUSTODIAN := :CTRL_BLOCK_1.G_CUSTODIAN;
 end if;
 select 'x' into temp
 from goals
 where decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:goals.chapter_id,chapter_id) = :goals.chapter_id --Decode added for IM 8335
 and goal_type = :goals.goal_type
 and goal_custodian = :goals.goal_custodian
 and goal_mmyy = :goals.goal_mmyy
 and nvl(blood_type,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:goals.blood_type,'XXXXXX')
 and nvl(donation_type,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:goals.donation_type,'XXXXXX')
 and nvl(procedure_code,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:goals.procedure_code,'XXXXXX')
 and rowidtochar(rowid)
 != nvl(rowidtochar(:goals.rowid),'X');
 show_error('11083');
 check_package_failure;
exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_MONTH_TOTALS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE display_month_totals IS
BEGIN
 set_block_property('s_goals',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 for i in 1..12
 loop
 :s_goals.month := to_date(to_char(i,'09')||'01'||:ctrl_block_1.year,'mmddyyyy');
 select nvl(sum(goal_count),0) into :s_goals.count from goals 
 where goal_MMYY = to_char(:s_goals.month,'MMYYYY') and 
 goal_type = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type and 
 goal_custodian = :ctrl_block_1.g_custodian and
 decode(chapter_id,'ALL',:global.chapter_id,chapter_id)= :global.chapter_id;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 set_block_property('s_goals',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 go_record(1); 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DONORS
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select donors.donor_id,
 first_name||' '||last_name donor_name
from donors,
 donor_interdictions donint
where donors.donor_id=donint.donor_id
 and donors.chapter_id='ALL'
 and donint.inter_code='DGOAL'
 and donint.chapter_id = donors.chapter_id
 and :ctrl_block_1.local_sys_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:ctrl_block_1.local_sys_date+10)
order by 2
